source.fit: Fitted to the saturation pressure of CoolProp 8.0.0 (MethylLinoleate: equation of state Huber-EF-2009; Huber et al., Energy & Fuels 23 (2009) 3790-3797, doi:10.1021/ef900159g); 200 points 265.000-799.000 K (narrowed: from the triple point (260.00 K, where the pressure is 1.5e-06 Pa) one DIPPR 101 curve does not meet the 1 % target; it starts at 265.00 K; fitted through the normal boiling point (the free fit missed it by +0.35 K)), max deviation 1.1 %.
